patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all Monet Launcher premium features by forcing the billing cache to always report premium as active.

patches_added.name: Disable Telemetry
patches_added.description: Disables ByteDance analytics by blocking LiteApplogServiceImpl, AppLogNetworkClient, and startup tracker init tasks.

patches_added.name: Hide CAPTCHA Popups
patches_added.description: Suppresses browsing CAPTCHA dialogs from SecApiImpl.

patches_added.name: Sanitize Share URLs
patches_added.description: Removes tracking parameters (utm_campaign, share_link_id) from shared links.

patches_added.name: Stop Video Looping
patches_added.description: Prevents videos from looping automatically after playback ends.

patches_modified.name: Disable Login Requirement
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok Lite mandatory login gate so the app can be browsed without an account.

patches_modified.name: Feed Filter
patches_modified.description: Removes ads, sponsored content, and commerce posts from the TikTok Lite home feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Live Cards
patches_modified.description: Removes live stream cards from the TikTok Lite home feed.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Pro
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Permission Pilot Pro by forcing isPro=true in the billing Info object.

patches_added.name: Fix RedGifs Audio
patches_added.description: Routes RedGifs embeds through the WebView iframe path so videos play with audio instead of using the silent direct-stream URL.

patches_modified.name: Bypass integrity check
patches_modified.description: Spoofs certificate fingerprint and SafetyNet results so login works on patched APK.

patches_modified.name: Disable auto-update
patches_modified.description: Disables automatic app update checks, the blocking update screen, and the proxy sponsor channel insertion. On Telegram Plus also disables the Plus-specific updater and update settings flag.

patches_modified.name: Download speed boost
patches_modified.description: Increases download chunk size to 1 MB and max concurrent requests to 12.

patches_modified.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_modified.description: Hides your typing indicator from other users in all chats. On Telegram Plus also silences the controller-level sendTyping dispatcher.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored messages and video ads from all chats and channels. On Telegram Plus also blocks native banner and inline ads.
